_note: DURABLE host-independent canon proof = canonical_crown_commit (ancestry) + required_paths + syntax_globs. These are the ONLY hard pins. expected_branch and expected_top_level were REMOVED 2026-06-09 after the GeForce real run: they are checkout/host artifacts (detached worktrees report branch=HEAD; top_level differs per host) and crown-ancestry is a strictly stronger lineage proof than branch-name (a branch can be reset to any commit; ancestry cannot be faked). canonical_repo_path is a dev default only — every host overrides with --root.

optional_host_pins._doc: A host MAY add expected_branch / expected_top_level to a LOCAL manifest copy if it wants stricter checkout enforcement. They are intentionally omitted from the canonical manifest.
